# Star Schema

One fact table of measurements surrounded by denormalised dimension tables that describe them. The
fact holds numbers and foreign keys; each dimension holds the text you group and filter by, flattened
so a query needs one join per dimension and never a chain of them. It is the deliberate opposite of
[[third-normal-form]]: redundancy is accepted because the workload is read-heavy analytical scans,
not transactional updates.

## Two independent instances

[[data-warehousing-and-business-intelligence]] builds the model twice, which is what makes it worth a
page rather than a paragraph.

**Mart A — retail sales.** `FACT_SALES` at order-line grain, with `DIM_TIME`, `DIM_PRODUCT`,
`DIM_CUSTOMER` and `DIM_SALESPERSON`. Five foreign keys are declared on the fact and three
non-clustered indexes cover the columns queries actually filter on. `DIM_PRODUCT` **collapses a
snowflake**: the source `Product → ProductSubcategory → ProductCategory` chain becomes one wide
dimension with a derived `IsPurchased` flag.

**Mart B — daily price quotes.** `FACT_QUOTES` at ticker-day grain over `DIM_DATE` and `DIM_TICKER`,
with derived columns (`DailyRange` as a `PERSISTED` computed column, `DailyReturnPct`, `RSI14`) and a
view on top that derives the overbought/oversold flags at read time rather than storing them.

## The parts that are easy to get wrong

- **Grain is declared by the primary key**, not by convention. See [[fact-grain]].
- **Role-playing dimensions.** `DIM_TIME` is joined twice from the same fact, as `OrderDateKey` and
  `ShipDateKey`. One physical dimension, two semantic roles — no second calendar table.
- **Degenerate keys.** `FACT_SALES` uses the source order-line identifier as its own primary key
  rather than inventing a surrogate; `DIM_TICKER` does the opposite. That contrast is
  [[surrogate-vs-natural-keys]].
- **What belongs in the fact and what belongs in a dimension** is the argument that produced
  [[measure-vs-dimension]] and [[rsi-as-measure-not-dimension]].
- **Nullable foreign keys are legitimate** when the business genuinely has none — see
  [[nullable-salesperson-key]].
- The dimensions must exist before the fact can reference them, which fixes the load sequence:
  [[etl-load-order]].

## Cost, stated in the source

The repo does not present the star as free. Comments name the price of each choice — a denormalised
product dimension repeats category text on every row, and deriving an indicator at query time "takes
two joins" rather than a single column read. That habit is [[provenance-and-limits-stated-inline]].
